procurement.first_purchase_order: must choose one visible candidate and one available logistics mode using material need, deadline feasibility, landed cost, processing time, transit time, MOQ, and reliability

inventory.raw_material_signal: remaining MATERIAL_1 is below the recipe requirement for the accepted demand gap

qualitative_constraints: The company is already operating and has visible committed demand.
Capacity, staffing, cash, and warehouse space must not dominate the diagnosis.
No supplier is registered during initialization or prewarm.
All configured supplier candidates and logistics choices are visible to procurement at takeover.
The first valid purchase order atomically registers its selected candidate; no separate hidden registration action is required.
The expected choice is determined from the current deadline and quantity, not from a hard-coded supplier or logistics answer.
anti_contamination_rules: Do not place a purchase order before handoff.
Do not expose a preferred supplier name in Agent prompts.
Do not force air logistics when a slower option still meets the deadline.
Do not let extra line construction, staffing, cash, or warehouse pressure become the primary bottleneck.
